title: Second Houthi Strike on Riyadh Airport Kills 1, Injures 11; Dammam Airport Also Targeted
detail: A fresh Houthi missile strike hit King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh — the second consecutive day of attacks — killing 1 person and injuring 11. Separately, Dammam's King Fahd International Airport was also targeted. The back-to-back strikes mark a sustained Houthi campaign against Saudi aviation infrastructure following the mass-casualty attack the previous day that killed 12.

title: Iran Offers to Mediate Between Houthis and Saudi Arabia Amid Escalating Airport Strikes
detail: Iran has offered to mediate between its Houthi allies and Saudi Arabia, a significant diplomatic signal amid escalating Houthi missile strikes on Saudi airports and infrastructure. The offer positions Tehran as a potential regional broker while it simultaneously maintains leverage through its support of the Houthi campaign.

title: Saudi Arabia Further Suspends Airport Flights After Latest Deadly Houthi Strikes
detail: Saudi Arabia has further suspended flights from its airports following the latest deadly Houthi strikes, with skies over the capital increasingly grounded. The escalating flight disruptions compound the economic and logistical toll of the sustained Houthi campaign against Saudi aviation infrastructure.

title: Saudi Arabia Investigates Air Defence Failure After Riyadh Airport Strike Kills 13
detail: Saudi Arabia has opened an investigation into how its air defence systems failed to intercept the Houthi missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed at least 13 people. The inquiry comes under mounting pressure to explain the breach, with the attack raising serious questions about the effectiveness of Saudi Arabia's multi-layered air defence network against sustained Houthi ballistic missile and drone salvos.
